introduce:
Lie down on your back, and put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Then lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.
name: LEG RAISES

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Raise up your legs faster and put them down slower.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don't pull your shoulders up off the floor.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too hard, put a little bend in your knees.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
This exercise targets your lower abdominals.

introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Stand in front of a chair. Then step up on the chair and step back down. \n\nThe exercise works to strengthen the legs and buttocks.
name: STEP-UP ONTO CHAIR

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Make sure your whole foot is on the chair.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale when you step up, and inhale when you step down.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, use a lower chair.
This exercise is good for your legs and gluteus.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. 

Take a step forward with your right leg and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel with the floor. 

Then return and switch to the other leg. This exercise strengthens the quadriceps, gluteus maximus and hamstrings.
name: LUNGES

tips.text: Take a big step forward.
Keep your legs at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your weight on your heels when pushing your body up.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Enlarge the distance between your feet if your knees are sore.
All of your leg muscles should be engaged.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, then put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward. Do a quick push-up and then jump up.
name: BURPEES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
Don't make your elbows point outward when doing the push-up.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.

introduce: Run in place while pulling your knees as high as possible with each step. \n\nKeep your upper body upright during this exercise.
name: HIGH STEPPING

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Do it as fast as you can.
Don't bend your back.
Breathe naturally.
To make it harder, raise your knees as high as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, slow down.
You can feel your heartbeat quickening.
This is a great exercise for your lower body.
This cardio exercise can strengthen your heart and lungs.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen lift your left leg and rotate your foot in circles.
name: SIDE LEG CIRCLES LEFT

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Make sure your body stays straight.
Your lifted leg should be directly over your body.
Breathe regularly.
To get more of a challenge, don't support yourself with your upper hand on the floor.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise works on your legs and lower abdominals.

introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.

introduce: Stand with your feet 6-12 inches apart. Stretch your arms in front of you.\n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your legs extended. Lift your left knee up and grab it with both hands. 

Pull your left knee towards your chest as much as you can while keeping your right leg straight on the ground. 

Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs lifted, knees bent and heels squeezed together. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nStraighten your legs and bring them back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your arms in front of you to keep balance. \n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Come half way up instead of coming all the way up, then squat down again. Repeat.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.

Your knees should not go over your toes.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.

Please keep your back straight.
